verdict: Hunter: Choose Hunter when domain email finding, verification, and light campaigns with clear published pricing are the primary jobs. Scores use the sales-intelligence editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Excellent ease of use for domain email finding and verification
Email campaigns/sequences included for light outbound
Strong value for SMB email-led prospecting
CRM connectors for common SMB stacks
weaknesses: Not a full enterprise contact mega-database
Lead scoring and deep enrichment are limited
Reporting is lighter than ABM platforms
Phone coverage is secondary to email finding
bestFor: SMB and founder-led teams that need domain email finding, verification, and light campaigns
Buyers who want transparent Free → Starter/Growth/Scale packaging
Outbound motions centered on email rather than phone or LinkedIn graph depth
notIdealFor: Enterprise teams needing deep phone-verified mobiles and org charts
Buyers whose primary job is multichannel LinkedIn/call sequencing
Teams that need multi-provider enrichment waterfalls
tradeoffs: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in
Published price transparency vs enterprise custom quoting
Specialization fit vs all-in-one SMB consolidation
recommendation: Choose Hunter when domain email finding, verification, and light campaigns with clear published pricing are the primary jobs. Compare Apollo for broader data+sequences, Snov.io for budget SMB finder+sequencer peers, Lusha for enrichment-first contact data, and RocketReach for named-prospect lookup.
editorialNotes: SI Priority-3 batch. Approved on sales-intelligence-editorial v1.0.0. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Strong for domain email finding and verification; not positioned as the deepest phone/firmographic enterprise database.
Domain search, bulk domain workflows, and list building are solid for email-led prospecting; weaker as a full firmographic ABM prospecting suite.
Useful email/company enrichment, but lighter than multi-provider waterfall or enterprise enrichment platforms.
Campaigns/email sequences are a first-party strength for light outbound on found emails.
CRM and workflow connectors are documented; solid for SMB stacks though not the deepest enterprise sync story.
Simple domain-finder UX is among the most approachable in the SI pool for founders and SMBs.
Campaign and usage reporting support outbound coaching; not an ABM analytics suite.
Free plan plus clear Starter-from-$49 published ladder is transparent and accessible for SMB buyers.

overallScoreRationale: Equal-weight average of 8 sales-intelligence editorial criteria, rounded to 1 decimal. Not a hands-on lab score.
